title: JRC / GloFAS return-period river flood hazard
description: Modelled inundation depth for seven return periods (10 to 500 years), cropped to the Kenya window. The MODELLED flood-prone baseline.

transfer.rationale: Re-run the ingest against its public origin rather than copying; the ingest is the definition of the dataset.
